svg.title: The Lab: specimens
svg.desc: How a Lab entry becomes pages. A Markdown file in src/content/lab is checked by the schema in lab-schema.ts, which feeds the Lab index and the detail page, the detail page also draws on the experiment and study registries, and a prebuild script renders its share card.
